description: Defines classes and methods for managing contact information within the OpenERP (Odoo) framework, including contact details, addresses, and associated jobs.

classes.name: res_partner_contact
classes.description: Model for contact persons associated with a partner, including personal details and related jobs.

classes.name: res_partner_address
classes.description: Model for partner addresses, with customized name display logic.

classes.name: res_partner_job
classes.description: Model representing a contact's role or function at a partner, linked to addresses and contacts.

methods.name: _title_get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of titles with 'contact' domain for selection.

methods.name: _main_job
methods.description: Computes the main job for a contact based on associated job records.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display name for contact records, combining title, name, and first name.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches contacts by name or first name with specified operator.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Customizes display name for partner addresses, optionally showing partner name.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display name for a job, combining contact name and function.

methods.name: onchange_partner
methods.description: Resets address when partner is changed in a contact's job record.

methods.name: onchange_address
methods.description: Sets partner ID based on selected address.
